summary: Phase 2 (Auth & RBAC) backend testing of Kingswell Institute PHP API on http://localhost:8090. Wrote pytest suite (21 tests, 10 test classes) covering login success/failure, rate limiting, account lockout, /api/auth/me, session regeneration, session expiry + opportunistic cleanup, sliding expiration, logout CSRF enforcement, RBAC (super_admin/student/admission_officer against admin-only + students-view diagnostics), audit logging, and bootstrap script idempotency. All 21/21 tests PASS. Verified HttpOnly cookie set, Secure flag absent locally (APP_ENV=local), generic 401 error message on invalid creds, 429 rate-limit response, users.locked_until DB column set after repeated failures, session sliding expires_at extension, CSRF header enforcement, opportunistic expired-session row cleanup, audit_logs rows for login/login_failed/logout, and idempotent super_admin bootstrap CLI.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthController and middleware chain look clean and correctly enforce session + CSRF + RBAC. No hardcoded secrets observed.
Rate limiter combines email OR IP by design — documented in credentials file; acceptable trade-off for local testing.

Opportunistic session cleanup only removes the specific accessed expired row (not a bulk sweep). Fine for now; recommend a periodic cron/cleanup task in a later phase to purge stale rows for inactive users.
Generic 'Invalid email or password' error correctly avoids user enumeration.
Bootstrap script is idempotent — safe to re-run.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — super_admin/admin@kingswellinstitute.uk, student/student.test@, admission_officer/officer.test@. All three accounts left intact and reset (failed_login_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL, login_attempts table cleared) after test run.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing 3 seeded accounts. Temporarily inserted rate-limit rows for a throwaway email 'ratelimit.test@kingswellinstitute.uk' in login_attempts table — cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 auth+RBAC fully verified. Regression suite is at /app/php-backend/tests/test_auth_phase2.py — run with `cd /app/php-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_auth_phase2.py -v`. Base URL http://localhost:8090 (Apache supervisor program 'kingswell-apache'). MySQL access: `mysql -u root kingswell` (no password). Note: rate limiter combines email+IP so tests reset login_attempts between classes. Future phases should add cleanup fixtures for user_sessions/login_attempts if new tests share state.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial test-script failures were fixed in-place: (1) requests.Session().cookies.get('kwi_session') raised CookieConflictError when a fake pre-existing cookie was set alongside the new server cookie — reworked assertion to check Set-Cookie response header + iterate jar. (2) expired-session cleanup assertion was too strict (expected all expired rows for a user gone, but middleware only cleans the accessed session) — reworked to start from a clean user_sessions table and verify count decreased.
